courses.title: Artificial Intelligence

Florida Tech Computer Science BS catalog "CSE 4001" "CSE 4301" "CSE 4272" restricted elective required courses
courses.note: CSE 4301 is the undergraduate AI course (cross-listed CSE 5290); the department course list (cs.fit.edu/DepartmentInfo/classInformation.php, marked out-of-date) lists no separate ML course. The 2014-2015 catalog syllabus (cs.fit.edu/Academics/undergradSyllabi/cse_4301.pdf) labels it an advanced elective; the fit.edu program page mentions an Artificial Intelligence track, and the current catalog (catalog.fit.edu, unreadable to automated fetch) could not confirm whether it is required, so treat it as an elective. The only recent public material is the instructor course web page (Spring 2024 coordinates, Fall 2023 syllabus links); it has no student AI-use policy, only a link to the university cheating and plagiarism handbook and an AI-and-ethics lecture topic. The linked Fall 2023 syllabus .doc returned 404, so no full syllabus was readable. No 2025-26 syllabus found.
